Third-party software in this package
====================================

DOSAGENT: https://github.com/aoresnik/dosagent
DOSAGENT itself is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE.TXT).

DOSAGENT.EXE was built with DJGPP (https://www.delorie.com/djgpp/) and
contains code from BearSSL and Watt-32, whose notices follow.


CWSDPMI
-------

CWSDPMI.EXE is the unmodified DPMI server from csdpmi7b.zip, Copyright (C)
1995-2010 Charles W Sandmann. See CWSDPMI.DOC for its terms.

You have the right to receive the source code and binary updates for
CWSDPMI. The source is csdpmi7s.zip, available from
http://sandmann.dotster.com/cwsdpmi/ and
https://www.delorie.com/pub/djgpp/current/v2misc/
